```
['run speech recognition inference on a dataset using a fairseq model checkpoint and compute WER', 'build an InferenceProcessor to load a model ensemble, set up decoding, and iterate over dataset samples', 'run the main inference loop that processes samples, computes edit distance, and writes WER results to a file', 'create an InferConfig dataclass with task, decoding, checkpoint, and distributed training settings for speech recognition', 'run the CLI entry point that registers Hydra configs and starts speech recognition inference with WER computation']
```
